metvplus.us.title: Mission: Impossible
metvplus.us.description: A group of extraordinary spies, each experts in their own fields, belong to the Impossible Missions Force (IMF) -- first headed up by Daniel Briggs and later overseen by Jim Phelps. The IMF is a government agency that undertakes only the most hazardous of espionage missions. The beginning of each episode featured the now-famous tape-recorded message outlining the latest task for the group to tackle. Popular during the Cold War, the group's missions usually centered on overthrowing the government of some small communist country causing problems for the free world. The IMF crew included disguise expert Rollin Hand, charmer Cinnamon Carter, electronics technician Barney Collier, strong man Willy Armitage and, in later episodes, disguise-master Paris. (Drama, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime) - 1966-09-17

retroplex.us.description: Loner government agent Singin' Sandy Saunders (John Wayne) witnesses what seems to be a stagecoach robbery, committed by young Fay Denton (Cecelia Parker). But Fay is actually just trying to get her hands back on her own money in order to keep it from thieving stooges Bert (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) and Elmer (Heinie Conklin) and their boss, local land grabber James Kincaid (Forrest Taylor). Saunders then teams up with Kay to fight off the gang and derail the criminal plots of the greedy Kincaid. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
retroplex.us.description: Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and a couple of his Rough Rider buddies -- Rusty (Raymond Hatton) and Tommy (Eddie Acuff) -- join the Border Patrol. First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.title: Down Missouri Way
retroplex.us.description: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright). (Musical comedy) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Driftin' River
retroplex.us.description: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help. (Western) - 1946

But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Stagecoach Outlaws

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Wild Boar Playbook

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E24 The Good Cop, Bad Cop Episode Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop while Nick plays the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E44 The Long Con Episode Kevin buys a cheap mask at a yard sale, but it may be a valuable art piece; Lindsey receives advice about her upcoming date with her crush.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E45 The Bigg Box Klub Episode The gang shop until they drop when they get a membership at a discount bulk store; Lindsey enters a speed-texting contest.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E54 The Blackout Episode A night out with the guys leaves Nick missing his wedding ring, along with his memories of the evening.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E50 The Kleptomaniac Episode Nick is asked to host a charity walkathon; Marilyn's bracelet is missing, and the children train to participate in the walkathon.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E14 The Suzanne Gets One-Upped Episode Nick plans a surprise belated honeymoon and uses work to cover up his plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E11 My First Job Episode Lindsey learns about stealing at the workplace when she lands her first job and gives out free food.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E20 The Quarantine Episode When Marilyn brings a dangerous flu back from a trip to Mexico, the family must stay inside their house under quarantine.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E33 The Pocket Dial Episode After Nick gets pocket-dialed by Suzanne and overhears her telling Gigi something personal, he gets back at Suzanne by fake pocketing dialling her.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E01 The Hyphenated Name Episode Nick and Suzanne have been married for about six months, and the new blended family is beginning to experience growing pains; Suzanne decides to hyphenate her name; Nick thinks the kids do not love him and will not accept him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E40 The Thanksgiving Episode The entire Kingston-Persons clan is at the house for a pot-luck Thanksgiving, but Suzanne's forgotten one thing, the turkey.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E29 The Fight Party Episode Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E05 The Cooking Episode Nick and Suzanne go head-to-head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is easy and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E32 The Suzanne's Surprise Party Episode Nick and the kids throw a birthday party for Suzanne because she has never had one.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E23 The Career Day Episode Nick confuses Kevin's classmates when he implies that networking is more important than studying and getting good grades.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E20 The Salsa Episode Annoyed that she and Nick never do anything together as a couple, Suzanne signs the two of them up for salsa lessons, but is surprised by her control issues on the dance floor.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E09 The Green Episode The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they realize sometimes you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E16 The Ghost Dog Episode The entire family plays pranks on one another, to the chagrin of Suzanne; when the family ignores Nick's choking because they think it's another prank, Nick has a near-death experience and embraces his Zen side.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E02 The We Ain't Going Out Like That Episode Nick tries to be spontaneous; Suzanne resists and plans a date night that fails; they attempt to be spontaneous together until they realize it's better if she plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E07 The Suzanne Theft Auto Episode Suzanne becomes overly consumed with Kevin's science project; Lindsey revs up for driving lessons, only to emerge as a suspect when her mother's car is scratched.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E08 The Second Black President Episode Kevin is torn between running a clean campaign for class president and being negative about his opponent.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E31 The Kevin Gets a Commercial Episode Kevin auditions for a commercial for the mall burger joint and ends up being replaced by a famous kid actor that looks just like him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E46 The Black Friday Episode Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E12 The Parent Teacher Trap Episode When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E09 The She Got Game Night Episode When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E33 The Mother's Day Episode Nick tricks Suzanne and Marilyn into spending a weekend together at a spa for Mother's Day, where it becomes clear it will take more than a masseuse to relieve the tension in the women's relationship.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E02 The Credit Check Episode Nick needs a new van for work, but Suzanne worries they are already too much in debt and cannot afford to buy a new one; Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E03 The Oh No She Di-in't Episode When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E53 The Good Day Seattle Episode The station launches a new morning show, but Nick's cohost is a self-serving reality star; Marilyn moves in with the family.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E08 The Michelle Obama Sweater Episode Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama sweater online; Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E12 The Tiger Dad Episode Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E28 The Nick Hosts a Telethon Episode Despite warnings from other co-workers, Nick gets stuck hosting a charity telethon; Suzanne has to deal with a rich client's boring wedding plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E10 The Despicable E Episode Lindsey's romantic attentions turn to a young celebrity DJ, who only neglects her in return; Suzanne teaches Kevin the art of doing laundry.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E06 The Booty Episode Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses; the kids want a larger allowance, but they're not willing to do more chores.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E15 The First .45 Episode When Lindsay tries to turn family members into stars of a reality television show, Kevin makes a discovery that brings too much reality to the Kingston-Persons household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E04 The Soccer Episode Kevin is a big football fan, but Nick does not understand the appeal; Suzanne is frustrated by Lindsey's lack of communication and creates a fake Facebook account to learn what is going on.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E35 The Life Insurance Episode Although Nick and Suzanne realize that life insurance would be a good decision to protect their family, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E07 The Viral Video Episode Suzanne gets caught dancing on a video that soon becomes a huge viral hit; Marilyn decides Lindsey needs to learn how to cook soul food.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E36 The Hypertension Episode When Nick gets a doctor's report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E25 The Mr. Almost Episode When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink; the results are not so bubbly.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E28 The Liar, Liar Episode Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E34 The Secret Episode Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E17 The Lemon Squeeze Episode When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E31 The Kwandanegaba Children's Fund Episode Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online; when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E21 The V.I.P. Tickets Episode Suzanne is furious when Nick invites Martin and not her to a baseball game; Kevin and Lindsey try to win tickets to Rihanna's Los Angeles concert.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E01 The Staycation Episode When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best vacation ever.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E23 The Compatibility Test Episode Suzanne meets a relationship adviser and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E26 The Big Loan Episode Confusion ensues when Suzanne asks Marilyn for a loan in an attempt to keep her birthday present a secret for Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E15 The Control Issue Episode When Nick points out that Suzanne has issues letting go of controlling everything, Suzanne lets everything go; the family realizes they need Suzanne's controlling ways to run a successful household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E48 The Concussion Episode After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours; to avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E19 The Disney Episode Nick is invited to play in a celebrity golf tournament at Walt Disney World; Suzanne has to miss the family's first vacation.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E04 The 22 Episode When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.

Eldridge makes it his mission to overcome the challenges of John's white supremacist upbringing, slowly beginning to forge a relationship through his foster son's fascination with extreme sports and BMX biking. fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E06 Hee Haw! Hee Haw! Teams of twins face challenges including racing through an electrified maze suspended over water, eating something gross and racing on a moving train while the teammate crashes through a locomotive.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E22 Helicopter Slalom, Piercings, Maggoty Cheese, Flag Snag Contestants must complete four stunts; players are pierced with long needles, and they eat cheese crawling with maggots.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E09 Dog Attack/Gas Chamber/Car Carrier Drive-Thru Contestants try to survive in a room full of tear gas. Host: Joe Rogan.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E01 Scorpion Tales Family duos take part in stunts that include hanging from a speeding helicopter, eating scorpions, and being attached to the grill of a semi truck.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E10 Water rises in a glass closet as contestants struggle to unlock the door and escape.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E11 Christmas Fear Factor Contestants try to swallow reindeer parts; players attempt to ride a scooter across a narrow plank 100 feet above the ground.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E08 Helicopter Drop, Slug Bugs Contestants must consume live slugs. Host: Joe Rogan.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E13 Contestants must transfer rats from one container to another using only their mouths. Host: Joe Rogan.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E14 Spin Cycle, Stilt Walking Contestants must consume balut -- eggs containing partially developed duck embryos -- as well as liquefied liver and dead silk worms in brine.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E15 Blizzard Show After a "blizzard" hits, contestants must balance on a spinning Ferris wheel while dining on pizza topped with bile and blood.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E16 All Gross Show Contestants must bob for objects submerged in 50 gallons of cow blood; players must eat tomato hornworms and then gather skunk carcasses from inside a darkened tunnel.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E17 All Female Fear Factor Female contestants must transfer electric eels from one container to another; players must straddle a bull-like object as it swings from a helicopter over a lake.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E18 Couples Show Four couples compete; a member of each couple tries to free the mate from a box submerged in water; contestants must remove roaches from a candy box using only their mouths.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E19 Flatbed to Flatbed; Worm Coffin; Tumbler Contestants try to make a car jump from one moving flatbed truck to another; players are covered in worms with only a straw to breathe through.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E20 Animal Themed Clip Show Clips from previous episodes feature snakes, rats, scorpions, bulls and alligators.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E21 Heli Boat Drag/Bull Buffet/Window Washer Contestants must leap from a raft, grasp a rope and climb it to a helicopter hovering above; players must ride a mechanical bull. Host: Joe Rogan.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E22 Helicopter Slalom, Piercings, Maggoty Cheese, Flag Snag Contestants must complete four stunts; players are pierced with long needles, and they eat cheese crawling with maggots.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E23 Las Vegas Show Contestants must slide down the facade of the pyramid-shaped Luxor Hotel & Casino in Las Vegas; the champion will bet half of his or her winnings on one hand of blackjack.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E24 Miss USA Contestants Six Miss USA contestants face their fears.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E25 Go Cart Chicken/Fear Factor Basketball/Water Rotisserie Contestants try to stop a kart on an elevated runway and unlock themselves from a board while being dunked underwater.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor USA
fearfactor.us.description: S03 E26 Helicopter Drop, Pot Lock Contestants must escape from a Plexiglas box while handcuffed and suspended from a helicopter; two contestants advance to the finals.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor 2.0 USA
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E07 The Bees Are Angry Contestants face five stunts that include dropping a teammate from a helicopter to a target below, being covered in and eating bees, and being shot through a window on the 13th floor of an office building.

fearfactor.us.title: Fear Factor
fearfactor.us.description: S07 E09 Leeches & Shaved Heads & Tear Gas, Oh My! -- Part 1 Contestants connected to a helicopter via bungee cord are ripped off a cliff's edge; other stunts include being submerged in a tub full of leeches and navigating through a five-story building engulfed in flames.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Tom Ford puts the Bentley Continental Flying Spur to the test; we take the fastest four-door saloon in the world on a tour of Britain and see just how many swanky events Tom can visit in 24 hours.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: The big names of the automotive world go under the hood to discuss reviews, news and bargains of the industry.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E01 Jason Plato helps a lottery winner choose a new supercar; Tiff Needell road tests the new Jaguar XK on the best road in the world; Tom Ford meets Jenson Button at the Geneva Motor Show.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E02 A crash test between a Land Rover Discovery and a Renault Espace evaluates safety differences between four-by-four vehicles and multipurpose vehicles.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson is the only British journalist invited to test drive Ferrari's new race car, the F430 Challenge; Tom Ford takes an exclusive one-off look into the secret world of the Maybach.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E05 We reveal the Best Cheap Car in Britain, meet the man who's giving away a free Ferrari to try and help sell his house, and a look round the country's ultimate supercar collection.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E06 Jason Plato teaches Girls Aloud how to become racing drivers; Tiff Needell drives the new Maserati Quattroporte, and Tom Ford tries to break the world record for doing donuts in a car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson learns how to become a spy photographer as she goes undercover trying to snap car manufacturer's secret prototypes; Tom Ford is in Japan driving the car of the future.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out exactly how well built a Mercedes is when she crashes it, drowns it in a flood and then drives over it in a monster truck.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E09 Find out what happens if you accidentally put diesel into a petrol engine; follow Tiff Needell as he races an Aston Martin DBR9S.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E11 Tom Ford flies out on Alan Sugar's private jet to test the brand new Audi TT, Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts a new land speed record, and Tiff Needell enters the inaugural D1GB drifting competition.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E12 Jason Plato tests the new 911 Turbo, Vicki Butler-Henderson presents a high speed crash test, and Tom Ford drives a new Lamborghini.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E13 We bring you the supercar battle when we pitch the McLaren F1 against the Enzo Ferrari; Jason Plato tries his hand at flying a stunt plane.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E01 "Fifth Gear" quite literally takes to new heights by staging a race between cars and planes.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the Lotus Elise S is the best track car for novices; Le Mans winner Guy Smith races the fastest van on sale today.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E04 Jon Bentley investigates how hitting a motorway crash barrier can make your car fly through the air. Jason Plato gives cricketer Kevin Pietersen the chance to drive the Lamborghini Gallardo Spyder.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E05 Jason drives the impressive 500bhp Ford Shelby GT500; Tiff races Mitsubishi's Evo 9 FQ360 against a former Red Arrow pilot's stunt plane.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the one-off supercharged Nissan Murano GTC; Jonny Smith challenges the big lawnmower to a head to head in a grass cutting contest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E07 Jason drives the Subaru Litchfield Type 25; Tiff drives the Ferrari 599 on the world's most treacherous roads.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson has a mini-moto race against some of the big names in bike racing; Tom Ford tests the new Land Rover Freelander on Britain's remote school run.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E10 Tom Ford's been testing the Mazda's new MX5 Roadster Coupe; Vicki Butler-Henderson has been thrashing Porsche's 911 GT3.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E11 Vicki is taught how to drive a car on two wheels; Jonny visits Germany for some extreme airbag testing.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S10 E12 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if an old Daihatsu Charade is the toughest car you can buy; Tom Ford drives the Honda CRV, the SUV that claims to be greener than a Mini Cooper.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E01 Vicki Butler-Henderson takes the new Fiat Panda 100HP for a spin around the track - against a Ferrari; Tiff Needell hits Las Vegas to try out Audi's first supercar, the R8.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E02 Vicki Butler-Henderson risks life and limb in the most dangerous car stunt of all, driving a car under a moving lorry; Jonny Smith tests the new Mercedes C Class and its revolutionary seat design.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E03 Tiff Needell employs the help of two models to test the theory that the quicker you drive a convertible, the less your hair blows. He blasts the brand new Bentley Continental GTC up to 150mph.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson makes an unprecedented attempt to hit 200mph in an A1 Grand Prix car; Tom Ford and Jonny Smith take the seven newest hot hatches on sale and decide which is best.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E06 Jason drives the Aston Martin V8 Vantage Roadster, Jonny tests the car James Bond drove in Casino Royale.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E07 Tom Ford tests the latest version of the car that is perennially voted one of Britain's favourite cars - the Land Rover Defender; Jonny Smith celebrates Ferrari's 60th Birthday.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E08 Tom Ford and Jonny Smith enter a demolition derby in two unlikely vehicles, Reliant Robins; Tiff Needell tests the latest Porsche 911, the GT3RS; Vicki Butler-Henderson drives the new Vauxhall VXR8.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E09 Vicki Butler-Henderson tests the latest BMW X5 4.8i; it's an impressive machine, costing £50,000, it does 150mph; Jason Plato tests the ultimate track car, the brand-new Lotus 2 Eleven.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S11 E10 Tom spends the day with the scourge of modern day motorists: wheel clampers; Vicki tests the Nissan 350Z.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E02 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out if the new 207 GTI is as exhilarating to drive as the 20-year-old hot hatch, the 205 GTI; Fifth Gear conducts a fascinating world's first crash test - we crash a 15-year-old Volvo 940.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E03 Diesel Mini vs a gas one; comparing the new Subaru Impreza to a previous version.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E04 Checking police driving skills on a racetrack; testing small economy cars on one of Britain's biggest hills.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E05 Comparing Audi TT's semi-automatic gearbox vs a manual one.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E07 Naming which TV cop car is fastest; celebrating the 75th anniversary of the Deuce Coupe; testing the Gumpert Apollo; building a drift car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E08 Tiff Needell gets behind the wheel of the cutting-edge Ferrari 430 Scuderia.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E09 A Lamborghini Gallardo Superleggera; a cider farmer who uses rotten apples to produce methane that powers his Jaguar.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S12 E10 Iwan Thomas accepts a stunt challenge from precision driver Russ Swift; Jonny Smith secretly repairs potholes; Tom Ford drives a Monster.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E02 Tom gets an advance look at Formula 1 supremo Bernie Ecclestone's rare and unusual collection of cars; Tiff and Jason take the BMW M3 and the Mercedes C63 AMG to a circuit to determine which is most deserving of its £50,000 price tag.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E03 Vicki finds out which is quickest, an old Vauxhall against a new one; Jonny Smith and Tom Ford contest one of motor sport's oldest and most grueling events, the Exeter Trial; Tiff Needell goes to France to drive the new Audi A3 Cabriolet.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E04 Vicki tests the Mercedes Vito X or the VW Transporter Sportline on the track to find out which is quickest; Jonny embarks on the 600-mile transcontinental trip in the BMW 635d; Tom drives the ultimate 4x4, the 12-ton, 10-foot tall Unimog.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out which is the fastest, the Renault Twingo GT or the Fiat Panda 100HP; Tiff Needell and Jason Plato go head-to-head; this time it's small coupes as the Porsche Cayman comes up against the new BMW 135i Coupe.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S13 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson is at Anglesey for another shoot-out; his time it's super chic superminis, the BMW Mini One against the Fiat 500; Jason Plato delivers his verdict on the Nissan Skyline now re-badged as the GT-R.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 Return of the New Century Galaxy Legend! O Armoured Hero, Stand Upon the Earth!: Not Normal Arc When two students are killed, one after the other, all the clues seem to point toward Hagakure, but Naegi questions the evidence.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 All All Apologies: (Not) Normal Arc Monokuma admits that he planted a mole and generously offers to let the students know who it is; the rift between the remaining students is worse than before.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 All All Apologies II Two of the main suspects for the fourth murder case are unsure of their own innocence; Naegi attempts to piece the clues together and figure out what actually happened.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 The Junk Food of Despair for Racing Through Youth: (Not) Normal Arc The group explores the fifth and final floor, which includes a botanical garden and classroom filled with blood; Kyouko is questioned on her identity, but insists she has no memory of it, due to her amnesia.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 The Junk Food of Despair for Racing Through Youth: Not Normal Arc Naegi and the others find themselves the unwilling participants in an awkward classroom trial; Monokuma seems to be plotting something.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 The Reason Super High School-Level Bad Luck Attracted Super High School-Level Murder ... Naegi is now almost certain that the principal is not the mastermind, leaving him to question who it could be; he discovers the principal's digital notebook, filled with vital clues for the trial.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 The Girl Flautist Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe are quickly becoming close friends as they continue to protect Eggs; however, as they grow closer, questions pile up and tensions rise.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Punch Drunk Day The girls are attacked by a dangerous new type of enemy while trying to protect their Wonder Eggs; Acca and Ura-Acca may have a solution, but Ai is more concerned with the budding relationship between her mother and Mr. Sasaki.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 After School at 14 It's Rika's birthday, and the girls get together to celebrate; Rika, however, is focused on her troubled relationship with her mother, and those worries carry over into her next battle.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 The Happy Friendship Plan Acca and Ura-Acca would like to sell a Wonder Egg; they explain the Eggs and introduce four of their regular customers: Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 A Story No One Knows The girls are surprised when Neiru invites them all to her house, and even more surprised to find out that she lives at her company.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 Confession Ai, Rika and Neiru confront Acca and Ura-Acca, but they are distracted by shocking news from Momoe; later, Momoe faces her toughest battle yet while Ai makes a difficult decision.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 An Adult Child The girls realize there's more waiting for them at the end of their missions; as doubts pile up and tensions rise, Ura-Acca decides to tell Ai his story.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 An Unvanquished Warrior Friendships are tested as Ai and Neiru realize how much victory has cost Rika and Momoe; Ai decides to fight again in spite of what she's learned, but the girl who emerges from her Egg this time may be more than she bargained for.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E05 Parallelism Crown At the concert of the popular band, REIJINGSIGNAL, Howan is chosen from the audience to go to the backstage party.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Heromeans Himeko is acting strange, so Howan tries different things to get her to open up.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 Endless Waltz of Crimson Flashing Wings with Guts Mashumairesh!! and DOKONJOFINGER have training camps; DOKONJOFINGER is in a curling competition.

crunchyroll.us.title: Show by Rock!! Mashumairesh!!
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 The Sky of Neon Tetras The newly-formed Mashumairesh!! gets a challenge to play in a battle of the bands.

crunchyroll.us.title: Radiant
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E15 With Fists Like Shooting Stars: Burst Hameline's past unfolds as she becomes infected and imprisoned with other infected children and Konrad usurps the Inquisition to carry out a barbaric plot to eliminate them.

crunchyroll.us.title: Radiant
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E16 Fly High and Pierce Through the Storm: Rising Seth's duel against Konrad comes to an end, but Hameline presents an even greater threat.

crunchyroll.us.title: Radiant
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E17 To Stop the Sound of the Wind: Serenade Seth fights Hamelin to save the town.

crunchyroll.us.title: Radiant
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E18 The Light That Follows the Darkness: Awakening Hameline is defeated by General Torque, the Beast; the enraged Seth continues to fight, but Von Teppes of the Inquisition turns the tables on him.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E10 Glimpse Beneath the Mask A tear on the Masked Fighter's headdress provides a peek into the warrior's true identity; Kuwabara refuses to fight.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E11 Ambition Destroyed: A Trial of Light The doctor's human experiments fight against their will; as Yusuke prepares to put them out of their misery, the Masked Fighter intervenes and suggests a peculiar plan.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E18 Memories of You Asta, Yuno and the others finally get to the treasure chamber, and they're in awe at the mountain of treasure in front of them; Yuno finds a strange scroll with strange writing, and then his grimoire does something strange.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E19 Destruction and Salvation Mars gets the upper hand in battle when he badly injures Asta and attempts to finish him off.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E15 Daring Commanders - The Doolittle Raid and The Stilwell Road James "Jimmy" H. Doolittle and Joseph Warren Stilwell.

combatwarchannel.us.title: German Fighters
combatwarchannel.us.description: Germany's front line fighters in World War II; pilots who flew the planes and officers who sent them into battle.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Night Bombers
combatwarchannel.us.description: During the winter of 1943-1944, RAF Bomber Command was sending massive raids almost every night into the heart of Germany.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Architects of Darkness
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Josef Goebbels Joseph Goebbels is widely known as the master of propaganda because he harnessed the combined power of radio, print, posters, film and oratory to shape the Nazi political agenda.

combatwarchannel.us.title: After Hitler
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 In the second part of the documentary, the Marshall Plan is examined more closely. In addition, flight and expulsion, the division of Germany and the air bridge to Berlin are also covered.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Price of Empire
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Blitzkrieg The Japanese turn back a Chinese counter-offensive; the Blitzkrieg Germany invasion of France; France falls; the British Army is evacuated from Dunkirk.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E23 Churchill's Finest Hour (April - June 1945) The Russians enter Berlin first; Hitler takes his own life in his bunker; the war in Europe finally comes to an end; Churchill leads the people of Britain in the VE Day celebrations; the fighting continues in the Pacific.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E24 Brave New World (July - September 1945) Tracking the main events of WWII with the help of archive footage; learning about Pearl Harbor, The Battle of Britain, D-Day, the dropping of the atomic bomb, and more; from the early battles right through to the complexities of the endgame.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Crusade in Europe
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E14 D-Day June 6, 1944: Allied forces land on the beaches of Normandy on D-Day.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Visions of War: : The Longest of Days
combatwarchannel.us.description: D-Day Eisenhower and his aides map the Normandy invasion; German pictures show the extent of their coastal defenses.

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 D-Day Convoy Activities just prior to and including D-Day; movements of American troops from all parts to Poe's prior to the Normandy invasion.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 The Battle of Britain After the evacuation of troops from Dunkirk and the Fall of France, Britain stands alone against Germany in an aerial battle fought from July to October 1940.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Rattling the Saber; The Gathering Storm; WWII Starts September 1, 1939 1939-1941; world events immediately preceding WWII.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Reich Underground
combatwarchannel.us.description: Hitler pins his hopes of victory in World War II on a plan for vast and intricate underground weapons installations.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Crusade in Europe
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E08 Sicily: Operation Husky Sicily is captured; Patton's Seventh Army sweeps into Italy.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Night Swallows
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E08 Episode 8 The Messerschmitt hit by the pilots falls in the forest, but does not explode; both Germans and Soviet scouts hunt for a night vision device built into its control panel.

combatwarchannel.us.title: David Jason's Secret Service
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History Sir David Jason looks into the origins of the British Secret Service.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Crimean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: The Valley of Death This program looks at the charge of the Light Brigade, when a misunderstood order sent troops straight into the main Russian artillery during the Battle of Balaclava; it also looks at the later Battle of Inkerman and the work of Florence Nightingale.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: Capitulation
combatwarchannel.us.description: May 8, 1945, while the Allied troops parade through liberated towns to cheering crowds, the Second World War is in its final hours.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Crusade in the Pacific
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E09 The Road Back: New Guinea Australian and American amphibious forces battle Japan in New Guinea.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Attackers
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 The captured Bes and one of the auxiliaries escape from the village and are then chased by the Germans.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Secrets of the Nazis
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Hitler's Junkies In 1939, Germany's blitzkrieg was fueled by Pervitin-crystal meth; newly declassified files expose how Nazi leaders weaponized drugs to drive conquest and sustain power.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft: WWI
combatwarchannel.us.description: An encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century; discussing the fighters of WWI, like the Nieuport 17, Albatross, Sopwith Camel, Fokker and more.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The War in Burma
combatwarchannel.us.description: The War in Burma in the Southeast Asian theater of World War II.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Price of Empire
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 A Day in Infamy The Germans advance into Moscow; the Japanese occupy Southern Vietnam and Cambodia; the Japanese attack Pearl Harbor on Dec. 7, 1941.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Direct Contact
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. (Action) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Eye See You
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Homeboy
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby. (Drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blitz
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gerry
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Bengaluru - Day 12 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E23 The road to the championship reaches a fever pitch at Mumbai's Jio World Garden for the second semifinal of the World Pickleball League Season 2. In this high-stakes "penultimate tie," the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans face off against a hungry Delhi Dilwale squad led by coach Wesley Gabrielsson. Witness a clash of styles as the dominant Katerina Stewart, who has lost only one match all season, battles the passionate Alejandra Lopez in a critical women's singles opener. Tactical brilliance is on full display as Max Mantor and Trang Huynh attempt to dismantle the Jawans' defense in a high-scoring mixed doubles "exhibition". With every strategic "Pickle Play" and intense baseline rally potentially deciding who advances to the grand finale, the atmosphere is electric and the margins for error are razor-thin.

pickletv.us.title: European Pickleball Championship : Women's Senior Singles Final - Linton vs. Tampieri
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E2 Witness one of the most exciting finals from the European Pickleball Championships 2025 in Rome. In the Women's Senior Singles Open Final, Team England’s Anna Linton takes on Team Italy’s Paola Tampieri at the iconic Stadio dei Marmi. Linton starts with commanding form, dominating the first game with powerful forehand drives. However, the momentum shifts as Tampieri, fueled by a passionate home crowd, adjusts her strategy to target Linton’s backhand and level the match.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 : US Open 2023 – Women’s Pro Singles Semifinal – Todd vs Jardim
pickletv.us.description: S1 E30 Two of the sport’s biggest names meet in this Women’s Pro Singles pre-medal match at the 2023 US Open. Parris Todd and Simone Jardim bring elite-level strategy, precision, and intensity to the court in a pivotal semifinal showdown. Who will rise to the challenge and advance?

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Delhi vs Chennai - Day 1 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E2 The World Pickleball League Season 2 continues its high-energy opening day at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai with a star-studded clash between Delhi Dilwale and the Chennai Super Champs. Watch as international stars like Delhi’s Max "Purple Jesus" Manthao and Chennai’s Hwang Nam Lee—a former Wimbledon junior doubles champion—bring world-class precision to the court. With celebrity co-owner Samantha cheering from the sidelines and strategic masterclasses from coach Wesley Gabrielsson, this tie features a gauntlet of intense Women’s Singles, Men's Singles, and high-speed Doubles matches. Experience every "Ernie" shot, tactical "pickle play," and the longest video challenge in league history as these two powerhouse teams battle for early-season dominance.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship : Ohio State University vs. University of Florida
pickletv.us.description: S2023 E6 The atmosphere reaches a fever pitch as the Ohio State Buckeyes and Florida Gators face off in a high-stakes battle for the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. Referee Kate Johnson sets the tone early, enforcing strict regulations on net contact and service line precision to ensure every point is earned through pure grit. Spectators will witness an intense racing flow as players scramble for kitchen control, showcasing the technical skills required to navigate high-speed volleys and strategic double bounces. With Florida utilizing critical timeouts to regroup against Ohio State’s relentless pressure, the match transforms into a display of freestyle athleticism and raw competitive spirit. Don’t miss a second of the action as these elite collegiate athletes fight to keep their championship dreams alive.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Wisconsin vs. Purdue
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E17 Live from The Picklr in Noblesville, this NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 matchup features a critical battle between the University of Wisconsin-Madison and Purdue University. With eight national bids and $5,000 in prize money on the line, the stakes are high as the 16th-seeded Purdue takes on the 17th-seeded Wisconsin in a best-of-seven format.The match kicks off with Gender Doubles, where Wisconsin’s duo of Noah and Sarah Sowinski showcase dominant net play and quick hands against Purdue’s Caleb Yang and Trevor Ju. Watch for standout moments, including an incredible Ernie from Wisconsin and strategic adjustments in the Mixed Doubles games involving Colton Thielman and Elena Schlichte.

pickletv.us.title: Picklebowl 2022 : – Mixed Doubles – Patterson & Taylor vs Fudge & Anderson
pickletv.us.description: S1 E8 The 2022 Picklebowl offers an unforgettable mixed doubles match featuring some of the biggest names in sports. US Olympian Casey Patterson and pickleball pro Chuck Taylor join forces to take on pickleball standout Megan Fudge and former tennis world No. 5 Kevin Anderson. Set against the scenic backdrop of Sea Island, Georgia, this unique event blends elite pickleball play with charity and college pride. Expect explosive rallies, pinpoint accuracy, and powerful serves in this high-energy exhibition that showcases the crossover appeal of pickleball.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championship 2026 : 2026 Pickleball US Open – Friday Match 2 - Livornese/Munro vs. Blanco/Diamond
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E2 The 2026 Franklin US Open Pickleball Championships continue with Friday Match 2 as Richard Livornese Jr. and Jack Munro take on Randy Blanco and Casey Diamond in a competitive doubles showdown. Featuring quick hands, strategic rallies, and high-level pickleball action, this matchup highlights the intensity and skill on display at one of the sport’s premier tournaments.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - Penn State vs. Liberty
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E23 Live from Virginia Beach, this Round of 16 matchup from the NCPA Virginia Beach Regional 2025 features Penn State battling Liberty University for a spot in the quarterfinals. With a bid to the National Championship on the line, the stakes are incredibly high in this win-or-go-home match.The contest goes the distance, pushing both teams to their limits. After splitting the initial six games 3-3, the match culminates in a dramatic Sudden Death Dreambreaker (Game 7). Watch standout performances from Liberty's John McCutcheon and Anneliese Brielle, who fight to keep their team alive, and Penn State's Caitlin Hartman and Theodore De Sousa, who deliver clutch plays under pressure.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - University of Arizona vs. Univeristy of Colorado - Boulder
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E7 The NCPA Nationals reach a fever pitch in Saint Louis as the University of Arizona Wildcats and the CU Boulder Buffaloes go head-to-head in a high-stakes, best-of-seven showdown. This elite showcase features "smash mouth" pickleball, where powerhouses like Eileen Tran and Frida Madsen utilize aggressive "Skills" to dominate the kitchen line. The intensity explodes during the "Racing" pace of sudden-death points, forcing competitors into a tactical "Freestyle" battle of wills as they navigate a tight center court with no room for error. With the series tied and mixed doubles on the horizon, every serve carries the weight of a national title.

pickletv.us.description: S1 E4 Get ready for thrilling Pro Men's Doubles pickleball action from the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships at East Naples Community Park, the National Pickleball Center! This semi-final match features the dynamic duo of Richard Livornese Jr. and Ryler Deheart against the formidable team of Ben Newell and Brandon Lane. Don't miss this high-energy competition from the epicenter of pickleball!

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Men's Pro Doubles - Munro/Yang vs. Bhatia/Mehta
pickletv.us.description: S1 E20 Welcome back to the 2025 Minto US Open Pickleball Championships for the Men's Pro Doubles semifinal match. This is a great representation of the sport's global growth, with the top-ranked player from India competing. The match features teams Munro and Yang against Bhatia and Mehta. The match is tightly contested, with the level of play stepping up as they enter the semi-finals. The caption file also notes that Bhatia's grandfather was a world-renowned cricketer in India with the nickname "the Sultan of Swing," which is comparable to an NFL star like Tom Brady.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Women's Pro Singles - Jardim vs. Kop

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA San Diego Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - UCLA vs. SDSU
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E15 Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

shadesofblack.us.title: Original Gangstas
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property
shadesofblack.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property 2
shadesofblack.us.description: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone. (Crime drama) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: Falcon Rising

shadesofblack.us.title: Bad Ass 2 : Bad Asses

shadesofblack.us.title: Pride

But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships. (Drama) - 2007

shadesofblack.us.title: Who's Your Caddy?

C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life. (Comedy) - 2007

shadesofblack.us.title: A Snowy Day in Oakland

(Comedy) - 2023

shadesofblack.us.title: A New Kind of Woman

outlaw.us.title: Two for Texas
outlaw.us.description: Escapees (Kris Kristofferson, Scott Bairstow) from a Louisiana penal colony join Sam Houston's Texas Volunteer Army and fight to avenge the Alamo. (Adventure) - 1998

outlaw.us.title: Across the Wide Missouri
outlaw.us.description: Tough trapper Flint Mitchell is a tenacious survivor in the unforgiving wilderness of the West. Determined to stay on the good side of the local Blackfoot tribe, Flint is intent on marrying Kamiah, the beautiful daughter of Ironshirt -- especially since this union would allow him to freely pursue his trade in the region. Struggling to win the approval of the protective Ironshirt, Flint finds himself truly falling for Kamiah. (Adventure) - 1951

outlaw.us.title: Along the Great Divide
outlaw.us.description: A U.S. marshal (Kirk Douglas) leads a lynch-mob survivor, his daughter (Virginia Mayo) and others across the desert to justice. (Western) - 1951

outlaw.us.title: There Was a Crooked Man
outlaw.us.description: After a botched heist, Wild West bandit Paris Pitman Jr. (Kirk Douglas) hides his newly stolen money where no one will find it, then loses his entire gang in a blaze of bullets before being captured by the law and given a lengthy sentence in a desert jail. Paris believes that he can buy his way out of his predicament by offering some cash to the guards, but the upstanding Sheriff Lopeman (Henry Fonda) makes sure his men remain honest. Running out of options, Paris begins plotting a jailbreak. (Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: The Big Land
outlaw.us.description: Civil War veteran Chad Morgan (Alan Ladd) and alcoholic ex-architect Joe Jagger (Edmond O'Brien) are taken in by kindly Kansas farmer Sven (John Qualen) and his widowed daughter-in-law, Kate (Julie Bishop). To repay their kindness, Chad and Joe concoct a plan to create a market town for cattle and grain, with the help of Joe's sister, Helen (Virginia Mayo), and her railroad executive fiancé (Don Castle). But the violent boss of a nearby market (Anthony Caruso) will kill to keep his monopoly. (Western) - 1957

outlaw.us.title: A Man Called Shenandoah - Run Killer Run
outlaw.us.description: Shenandoah is hunted by a professional killer. (Western) - 1966-01-10

outlaw.us.title: Bonanza - Denver McKee
outlaw.us.description: The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter. (Drama, Western) - 1960-10-15

outlaw.us.title: The Ballad of Cable Hogue
outlaw.us.description: After he is abandoned in the desert without water, Cable Hogue (Jason Robards) wanders for days until he finds a supply of water in a muddy ditch. Determining that the spot is the only spring in the area, Cable decides to start a business offering water to passing stagecoaches. Aided by his new friend, Joshua (David Warner), and a prostitute named Hildy (Stella Stevens), Cable builds a successful business. However, when motorcars start to pass, Cable realizes his trade is down to its last days. (Comedy, Western) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: The Cheyenne Social Club
outlaw.us.description: Cowboy John O'Hanlan (James Stewart) is surprised to learn that someone's left him a business in Cheyenne, Wyo. He sets out to claim it -- and is shocked to discover that it's a brothel. Madam Jenny (Shirley Jones), who runs the place, is dismayed when O'Hanlan wants to close it down, but his plans are derailed when he finds out that a local customer has beaten Jenny. He kills the man in a shootout, and then must protect himself and the girls from the dead man's vengeful clan. (Western, Comedy) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: The Rounders
outlaw.us.description: Ben Jones (Glenn Ford) and Howdy Lewis (Henry Fonda) are cowboys who spend their days breaking horses and flirting with two sisters (Kathleen Freeman, Joan Freeman). When Ben and Howdy trade Ol' Fooler, an unbreakable horse, for corn liquor, the client returns the horse after it passes out from drinking whiskey. The cowboys grow fond of Ol' Fooler and, knowing that he is nearly impossible to ride, enter the horse in the rodeo hoping to make their fortune. (Western, Comedy) - 1965

outlaw.us.title: Apache Rifles
outlaw.us.description: A U.S. Cavalry officer (Audie Murphy) falls in love with a part-Indian missionary (Linda Lawson) in Arizona. (Western, Action) - 1965

outtvproud.us.title: Rise: Blood Hunter
outtvproud.us.description: Sadie (Lucy Liu), a reporter, investigates an underground cult in Los Angeles which seems to be responsible for a series of grisly murders. While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all. (Horror, Thriller) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: The Grudge 3
outtvproud.us.description: Jake (Matthew Knight), who nearly lost his mind after battling a vicious Japanese curse, is living in a mental hospital. Dr. Sullivan (Shawnee Smith) is assigned to determine if his wild stories are true. A trip to Jake's apartment convinces her that they are, and Sullivan soon discovers that the vengeful spirits Toshio (Shimba Tsuchiya) and Kayako (Aiko Horiuchi) have latched onto a new family. Only the mysterious Naoko (Emi Ikehata) knows how to stop them once and for all. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps
outtvproud.us.description: The story of two outcast sisters, Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins), in the mindless suburban town of Bailey Downs. On the night of Ginger's first period, she is savagely attacked by a wild creature. Ginger's wounds miraculously heal, but something is not quite right. Now Brigitte must save her sister and save herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps II: Unleashed
outtvproud.us.description: A patient (Tatiana Maslany) at a rehabilitation center tries to prevent a young woman (Emily Perkins) from transforming into a werewolf. (Horror) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Ginger Snaps Back: The Beginning
outtvproud.us.description: In early 19th-century Canada, orphaned sisters Ginger (Katharine Isabelle) and Brigitte (Emily Perkins) find themselves lost in a forest while riding on horseback. They're rescued by The Hunter (Nathaniel Arcand), a mysterious Native American who takes them back to Fort Bailey. Something strange has happened there, however. The few settlers who remain are suspicious of outsiders and keep tight-lipped about the situation, but Ginger soon discovers their secret for herself. (Horror, Thriller) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Bug
outtvproud.us.description: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair. (Drama, Thriller, Horror) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: The Grudge 3
outtvproud.us.description: Jake (Matthew Knight), who nearly lost his mind after battling a vicious Japanese curse, is living in a mental hospital. Dr. Sullivan (Shawnee Smith) is assigned to determine if his wild stories are true. outtvproud.us.title: Big Sky
outtvproud.us.description: Two masked gunmen attack a woman and her agoraphobic daughter as they travel by van to a treatment facility. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

outtvproud.us.title: The Cold Light of Day
outtvproud.us.description: Young business consultant Will Shaw (Henry Cavill) flies to Spain for a vacation aboard his family's sailboat. When Will returns from some on-shore shopping, his family is gone and will be killed if he does not deliver a missing briefcase within 24 hours. As it turns out, his father (Sigourney Weaver) is not a cultural attaché but a spy, and Will is in over his head. He must find a way to turn the tables on his enemies, or he and his family will all die. (Action, Thriller) - 2012

outtvproud.us.title: 3 Generations
outtvproud.us.description: Hoping to get support from his mother (Naomi Watts) and grandmother (Susan Sarandon), a New York teen (Elle Fanning) prepares to transition from female to male. (Comedy drama, LGBTQ) - 2015

outtvproud.us.title: Generation Um...
outtvproud.us.description: In New York, an escort-service driver (Keanu Reeves) and his two pretty friends (Bojana Novakovic, Adelaide Clemens) document their escapades with a stolen camera. (Drama) - 2012

outtvproud.us.title: Freeway
outtvproud.us.description: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1996

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

portlandia.us.description: S03 E02 Take Back MTV Spyke and Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens; a group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor; Sandra has a crush on a mysterious man in her meditation class.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E03 Missionaries The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland; pedicab driver hustles for clients; Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E05 Squiggleman Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music; The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement; Malcom and Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E06 Off the Grid Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid; a dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland; musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E07 The Temp A temp worker hopes to turn her stint as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help; a wedding is interrupted; local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto; Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E08 Soft Opening Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the soft opening of their bed and breakfast; a magazine features a local furniture maker in their Man Issue; steampunks attend a convention; Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E09 Alexandra The City of Portland is overrun with art projects; Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate Alexandra; a movie theater sells artisanal concessions. Kath and Dave are concerned about the coyotes in their neighborhood.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E10 No-Fo-O-Fo-Bridge The Rats decide to move out of their newly-gentrified neighborhood; first-time parents read various child-rearing books; Gavin and his girlfriend go to the movies; Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E11 Blackout Electricity is shut off for the entire city as a result of unpaid bills at the Mayor's office; Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E01 Sharing Finances A young woman is haunted by very smart ghosts; Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another; Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes; Sandra finally finds a soul mate; Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E02 Ecoterrorists Ecoterrorists protest animal testing at a makeup company; Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out!; Toni and Candace have a car wash; Fred misses hip hop; Dave helps Kath get a good night's sleep.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E03 Celery A celery salesman goes to great lengths to have celery become more popular; 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets; The Order Grill is open for lunch; Carrie declares social bankruptcy; a fed up office worker wants to become a gutter punk.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E04 Pull-Out King A punk from the 1980s wakes up from a coma; an e-mail goes neglected; Nina has surprising news for Lance; Malcolm and Kris tailgate a "Prairie Home Companion" live show; Carrie dates a tax lawyer.
