tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Dream Island Home After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Forest Treehouse Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Countryside Cabins Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Invest In Your Kitchen Diane and Bernard are downsizing. They're counting on Nicole and Caffrey to get them top dollar! And back in the city, Whitney is struggling to make her townhouse function properly. Nicole and Caffrey bring their magic to transform this townhouse!

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 A Dream Childhood Home Lauren's childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys, while real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.

tastemadehome.us.title: Styled
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Townhouse Transformation Nicole and Caffrey transform a townhouse into an absolute dream for Nicole and her two daughters, while helping real estate pro Chris uncover and stage this cluttered suburban listing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E01 Comfy Campground Medical doctors and busy parents, Cynthia and Boon miss their camping adventures. Brian and Sarah perform some backyard surgery, and build them a cozy campground retreat so they can go straight from the ER to getting some R&R right in their own yard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 Luxury Staycation Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Mid-Century Poolside Retreat Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Full Throttle Dream Homes We meet Steven. He is looking for a place to spend his weekends that will accommodate his love of Motor Sports. Viviana is taking him through some of the most desirable properties in this one-of-a-kind Motor Sports Country Club.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 The Ultimate Home for Art Lovers George and Bill are looking to cut their commute and move to the city. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Palo Alto, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E01 A Backyard Fit For A Millionaire Doug and Nicole are searching for a new luxury home in Los Angeles, California. They need a house that's closer to their clients. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E13 A Villa Escape With Classic Charm Darren and Meg are relocating from the East Coast. They're looking for better weather year round. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Pasadena, California. The want California living with character and a modern twist.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 A Perfect Home To Start A Family Kevin and Danielle are looking for a home for their growing family. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Pasadena, California. Will they find their dream home?

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul - Touring the Cradle of Western Civilization
truehistory.us.description: The dynamic civilizations that emerge in the Aegean; the scope of the human drama that is played out there; some of the towering figures and remarkable sites to encounter; Professor Hale's recommendations for traveling this world as the ancients did. (Travel) - 2011-10-28

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul - Athens - Around the Acropolis and Parthenon
truehistory.us.description: The Acropolis is a symbol of Athens; the path of the ancient annual procession honoring Athena; the history and meanings of the site's iconic buildings; the superlative architectural features of the Parthenon and its surprising original uses. (Travel) - 2011-10-28

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul - In the Footsteps of Socrates - Historic Athens
truehistory.us.description: Treasures surrounding the Acropolis; the Theater of Dionysos, where one ponders the rituals of early dramatic festivals; the Odeon of Herodes Atticus, a venue of music and recitations; the Pnyx, an ancient hilltop assembly point; the agora market. (Travel) - 2011-10-28

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Greece and Turkey, From Athens to Istanbul - Around Attica - Temples and Mysteries
truehistory.us.description: Visiting sacred monuments of Greece's beautiful Attica region; the Amphiareion is a shrine of a prophet deity; ancient oracle and healing practices; imposing shrines to Artemis and Poseidon; Eleusis is the site of mystical religious rituals. (Travel) - 2011-10-28

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages - Point Zéro: Charting Our Course
truehistory.us.description: Contemplating the French art de vivre and the appeal that makes France one of the most visited tourist spots; an overview of the upcoming journey across the rich cultural landscape of France; learning about the iconic figure of Charles de Gaulle. (Travel) - 2020-03-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages - The Birth and Rise of Paris
truehistory.us.description: Learning how Paris evolves from an ancient settlement to a Roman city and then the capital; studying medieval Paris through the Cluny Museum, the great cathedral of Notre Dame and the royal chapel of Sainte-Chapelle; following the growth of Paris. (Travel) - 2020-03-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages - The Splendor of Versailles
truehistory.us.description: Discovering the Palace of Versailles as the world of Louis XIV; noting how the landscaping surrounding the palace symbolizes features of Louis's reign and how the Versailles court prizes royal spectacle; exploring Louis's patronage of the arts. (Travel) - 2020-03-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: France Through the Ages - Paris in Revolution
truehistory.us.description: Examining the social and political background of the French Revolution of 1789; visiting key locations in Paris where the events unfold, from a coffee house to the site of the Bastille prison and the Place de la Concorde; mapping Napoleon's rise. (Travel) - 2020-03-27

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - How Washington DC Came to Be
truehistory.us.description: Uncovering the origins of the District of Columbia; how the location for the national government is chosen; the original design and vision for the city by artist and engineer Pierre Charles L'Enfant; the creation and history of the National Mall. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The White House and the Presidency
truehistory.us.description: Tracking the history and fortunes of the White House; visiting the White House, beginning with the Oval Office and Cabinet Room; visiting the parks adjoining the White House; the Jefferson and Franklin Delano Roosevelt memorials. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The Capitol Building and the Legislature
truehistory.us.description: How the Capitol building is designed, constructed and expanded in the early years of the nation; touring the architectural and artistic wonders of the building; concluding with the House and Senate Chambers; the surrounding parks and gardens. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Washington D.C. - The Supreme Court and the Law of the Land
truehistory.us.description: Studying the founding and history of the Supreme Court; touring this structure, its interior features, court facilities and artistic decoration; exploring the Court in action, which encompasses courtroom procedure and how cases are processed. (Travel) - 2019-03-29

truehistory.us.description: The sights and smells of the medieval city; exploring the rich details of markets, monasteries, churches and religious and civic events; life in the townhouses of the rich, the tenements of the poor; the activities of medieval societies. (Educational, History) - 2013-11-15

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: Experiencing Medieval Europe - Rothenburg - Jewel On the Romantic Road
truehistory.us.description: A well-preserved German medieval city; exploring the imposing mansions of the city's former elite, the grand fountains and the market square with its remarkable gothic town Hall; visiting St. Jakob's Church; walking the bastions of the city walls. (Educational, History) - 2013-11-15

truehistory.us.description: What one can learn about different cultural groups through the lens of their cookbooks; looking at two chicken recipes 200 years and a continent apart; learning to cook dishes from a 1748 French cookbook and "The Can-Opener Cookbook" of 1953. (Cooking, How-to) - 2020-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Ancient Rome: Cooking with Apicius
truehistory.us.description: Whether the recipes in "De re coquinaria" are bizarre and disgusting, or they reflect a time of elegance and luxury; exploring its sala cattabia, minutal of apricots and botellum; finding three delicious, and even somewhat familiar, dishes. (Cooking, How-to) - 2020-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Imperial China: Soybeans and Dumplings
truehistory.us.description: Examining the Chinese Wei dynasty's "Qi Min Yao Shu"; learning about Chinese agricultural practices going back to antiquity; the fermentation practices of the time; following a scaled-down recipe to create a fermented black bean dish. (Cooking, How-to) - 2020-04-24

truehistory.us.title: Cooking Across the Ages - Medieval Egypt: Chickpeas and Phyllo Dough
truehistory.us.description: Exploring recipes from 14th-century Egypt that reflect the interchange between the many cultures of the Eastern Mediterranean of the time; learning to make himmas kassa and a light and flaky phyllo dough stretched to the size of a table. (Cooking, How-to) - 2020-04-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Saigon Noodles for Breakfast
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favorite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chili Crab Claws. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Malaysian Flying Noodles and Pork Bone Soup
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Jakarta's King of Street Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food". (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hacienda Ranch Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
tastemadetravel.us.description: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tradition and Innovation
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja. (Cooking) - 2024-03-14

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Saigon Noodles for Breakfast
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favorite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chili Crab Claws. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Pierogies, Bagels, and Ramen in NYC
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza takes a LOT of bites out of the big apple as he samples warm pillowy bagels & schmear, grabs pierogies at an old school Ukrainian spot, gets the scoop on innovative ice cream flavors, and slurps up some real ramen. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-10-12

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Fish Tacos, Bacon Burgers & Bucatini in San Francisco
tastemadetravel.us.description: Let's dig in. Join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through San Francisco's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From classic diner bites to fusion feasts to waterfront fish tacos, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Chicken Fried Steak, BBQ & Biscuits in San Antonio
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ready for Texas-sized flavors? Join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through San Antonio's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From authentic Tex-Mex to Hill Country BBQ, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Smothered Pork Chops, Ramen & Fried Flounder in Charleston
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pull up a seat and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through Charleston, South Carolina's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From coastal soul to Lowcountry classics, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Picasso Pasta, Custard Cups & Cowboy Steaks in New Jersey
tastemadetravel.us.description: Grab your fork and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through New Jersey's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From silky custard cups to pasta Picasso to giant pizza slices, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Salmon Tacos, Meatballs, & Perogies in Las Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie dazzles in Las Vegas where he enjoys crunchy salmon skin tacos, an homage to after-school snacks, and the dish that put Martha Stewart on the map. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - BBQ, Pizza, & Noodles in Nashville
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie visits Nashville for smoky BBQ Pork, hand-pulled noodles, a luxe burger, and hand-pulled noodles. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - No Sleep Til Brooklyn
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds gets neighborhood goodness at Bonnie's, a truly original Cantonese American concept, mind-blowing plant-based bites and retail at Aunts Et Uncles, and chophouse revival at Gage & Tollner. Plus art galleries, shopping and best pizza. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - Taking a Big Bite out of Boston
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds explores heritage-inspired spots in Boston including La Royal, dinner party-inspired Peruvian seafood restaurant, handmade German goodness at Bronwyn and over-the-top tiki culture at Wusong Road; plus the best oysters in town. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - Leveling Up in New York City
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds explores cutting edge concepts in NYC including Michelin star-winning Contra and Wildair, Madame Vo, a Vietnamese restaurant inspired by powerful women, and Dhamaka, an explosive Indian eatery. Plus shopping, art and best sandwiches. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - The Soul of Los Angeles
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds hits restaurants inspired by heritage, including Cobi's - where maximalism meets Southeast Asian, the California comfort food of Alta Adams and Yangban Society's colorful Korean-American deli concept. Plus the best tacos in LA. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Big Appetite - LA's Hometown Hero
tastemadetravel.us.description: Ben Hundreds spins through his hometown of L.A. visiting Chifa, a fashion-infused Peruvian/Chinese restaurant, authentic Mexican at La Casita Mexicana and Motherwolf - Evan Funke's opulent Roman spot. Plus art galleries, shopping and burgers. (Travel, Cooking) - 2022-08-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-02-04

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-02-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes! (Cooking) - 2020-02-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Sipping Gin in Sapa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-14

themarthastewartchannel.us.title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
themarthastewartchannel.us.description: Martha Stewart offers home cooks a culinary master class which covers everything from roasting and poaching to braising and blanching. In each 30-minute episode, Martha uses her signature step-by-step, how-to teaching process to illustrate classic cooking techniques as well as the basics every cook should know. Lessons include making marinara sauce with four ingredients, butchering a beef tenderloin, cooking chicken breasts in parchment paper and how to determine which meats are good for braising. classica.us.title: Verdi, Messa da Requiem
classica.us.description: Giuseppe Verdi (1813-1901): "Messa da Requiem". Anja Harteros (Sopran), Elīna Garanča (Mezzosopran), Jonas Kaufmann (Tenor), René Pape (Bass), Chor und Orchester des Teatro alla Scala; Leitung: Daniel Barenboim. Verdis "Requiem" zählt neben Ludwig van Beethovens "Missa solemnis" und Johannes Brahms' "Deutschem Requiem" zu den großen Meisterwerken geistlicher Musik des 19. Jahrhunderts. Für diese Aufführung in der Mailänder Scala wurden vier herausragende Solisten verpflichtet. (Special, Music, Event) - 2014-11-23

classica.us.title: Jaroussky singt Bach & Telemann
classica.us.description: Philippe Jaroussky ist der Superstar der hohen Töne. Auf dem Höhepunkt seiner Karriere gastierte er bereits auf fast allen Bühnen der Welt. Für die Konzertsaison 2015/16 hat er sich einen langersehnten Traum erfüllt: Mit Unterstützung des herausragenden Freiburger Barockorchesters widmet er sich den Kantaten Bachs und Telemanns. Die Musikdokumentation begleitet Jaroussky zu den CD-Aufnahmen in Freiburg und gibt Einblicke in die präzise Arbeit des Künstlers. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2017-04-09

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
classica.us.description: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik. (Music) - 2008-04-16

classica.us.title: Berlioz : Symphonie fantastique, op. 14
classica.us.description: Das Armenische Nationalphilharmonische Orchester führt Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14 auf. Dieses ist unter der Leitung von Dirigent Eduard Topchjan. Komponiert wurde das Stück von Hector Berlioz im Jahr 1830. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-03-05

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-01-03

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: IVC 2021 - Finale: Schubert, Hahn, Ullmann u. a
classica.us.description: Matthias Hoffmann und Lisa Ochsendorf führen unter anderem "Il modo di prender morale" auf. Diese Aufführungen stammen aus dem Finale der International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo und wurden in 's-Hertogenbosch, Niederlande, aufgezeichnet. (Music, Classical) - 2023-09-12

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 1
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs Reihe der sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte gehört zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Zu ihrem 300-jährigen Jubiläum im Jahr 2021 spielten Václav Luks und das renommierte Barockensemble Collegium 1704 alle sechs Brandenburgischen Konzerte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-04

classica.us.title: Vokale Barockwerke von Cavalli, Strozzi und Bembo
classica.us.description: Der argentinische Dirigent und Cembalist Leonardo García Alarcón führt sein Ensemble Cappella Mediterranea durch ein Programm italienischer Barockmusik. Das Ensemble spielt einige der schönsten Barockstücke von Francesco Cavalli. (Special, Music) - 2022-08-12

classica.us.title: Arien, Soli und Duette von J. S. Bach
classica.us.description: Bariton Matthias Goerne, Violinist Vilde Frang, Cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, Flötist Stathis Karapanos und Cembalistin Michaela Hasselt widmen sich der Musik von J. S. Bach. Dieses Konzert wurde in der Marienkirche in Wittenberg aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-04-14

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

classica.us.title: Werke für Cello und Klavier: Debussy, Brahms u.a
classica.us.description: Silvia Chiesa und Maurizio Baglini präsentieren ein Konzert im Rahmen des Amiata Piano Festivals 2023, das im Forum Fondazione Bertarelli in Poggi del Sasso in Italien gegeben wurde. Es wurden Stücke von Claude Debussy und Johannes Brahms gespielt. (Special, Music, Event) - 2025-01-06

classica.us.title: Misha Enzovoort
classica.us.description: Für Misha Mengelberg hat das Vergessen begonnen. Er wartet auf ein Taxi, das er nicht gerufen hat, um zu einem Konzert zu fahren, das nicht stattfindet. Der niederländische Komponist, Pianist und Meister des Jazz Misha Mengelberg, geboren 1935, taucht immer tiefer in das Dunkel der Demenz, die sein Musikerleben beendet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2017-05-19

classica.us.title: Tschaikowsky - Ouvertüre-Fantasie aus Romeo & Julia
classica.us.description: Conrad van Alphen dirigiert die Sinfonia Rotterdam in einer Aufführung von Peter Iljitsch Tschaikowskys Ouvertüren-Fantasie „Romeo und Julia". Unter seiner Leitung hat sich der Klangkörper zu einem beliebten Orchester in den Niederlanden entwickelt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-06-30

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight

classica.us.title: Werke für Cello und Klavier von Schumann u.a
classica.us.description: In Genf, der Stadt, in der sie den größten Teil ihres Lebens verbrachte, lädt die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich ihren langjährigen Musikpartner, den Cellisten Mischa Maisky, zu einem privaten Kammermusikkonzert ein. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-09-28

classica.us.title: Brahms Tragische Ouvertüre & Mahler Sinfonie Nr. 1
classica.us.description: (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-10-11

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 8
classica.us.description: Mahlers 8. Symphonie, auch bekannt als die Symphonie der Tausend, ist ein monumentales Chor-Epos aus dem Jahr 1906, das ein riesiges Ensemble aus Solisten, Chören und einem gewaltigen Orchester erfordert. (Special) - 2026-03-28

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonien und Klavierkonzert Nr. 4
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer leitet sein Budapest Festival Orchester in einem Konzertprogramm, das der Musik von Ludwig van Beethoven gewidmet ist. Das Programm beginnt mit der Symphonie Nr. 1 in C-Dur, Op. 21 und Beethovens Klavierkonzert Nr. 4 in G-Dur, Op. 58. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-05-10

classica.us.title: Bach - Partita Nr. 2 und Sonate Nr. 3
classica.us.description: Die Geigerin Isabelle Faust spielt zwei Solowerke für die Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für die Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-04-21

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - Violinkonzert, op. 35
classica.us.description: Simone Lamsma spielt mit dem London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von Gianandrea Noseda Pjotr Tschaikowskis Violinkonzert in D-Dur. Bei diesem Konzert aus der Londoner Barbican Hall entfacht Lamsma ein virtuoses Feuer. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-11-01

classica.us.title: Mozarts 38. Sinfonie, KV 504
classica.us.description: Gerd Albrecht dirigiert die Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie bei einer Aufführung von Mozarts 38. Prager Sinfonie. Mozart komponierte sie Ende 1786, die Premiere fand im Januar 1787 während des ersten Pragbesuchs des Komponisten statt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-06-05

classica.us.title: The Pianists Keys
classica.us.description: Der Film berichtet über zwei junge Pianisten an der Internationalen Klavierakademie im Engadin. (Special, Documentary, Music) - 2021-01-04

classica.us.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2021-09-24

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E10 Croc-A-Bye Baby / Wanna Eampanada? / If The Boot Fits / Pinata Party Dora & Boots babysit some rowdy crocs. // Dora & Boots get the Troll to try an empanada at Benny's stand. // Boots tries new boots that Tico invented. // The twins have their first pinata party.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E2 Goldie's Fintuition / Raising Remy When Goldie becomes a psychic, Baby and William set out to make her predictions come true. / Baby and William look after a baby reef rabbit and learn how difficult it is to be a parent.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E10 Spark Bug Blaze, Stripes & AJ are racing through the jungle when Stripes discovers a lost little fire beetle named Sparky. Blaze and his friends set off across the jungle to help Sparky get back home.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E11 Fire Alarm Blaze Blaze gets an urgent call from the fire chief saying there's a fire on the bridge and he needs extra help, so it's up to Fire Engine Blaze and AJ to hurry and save the day.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E4 Pups Stop The Cheetah When the Cheetah swipes the Paw Patroller to fulfill her nefarious plan to destroy the jungle and build the cheating-est racetrack ever, the Paw Patrol must get a brand vehicle and stop her!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E5 Pups Save The Mustache/pups Save The Funhouse The Pups help find Mayor Humdinger's mustache after he accidentally shaves it off. // A carnival train gets stuck in a tunnel, it results in a mountainside funhouse-style wild ride.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tim Rex in Space
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E5 Moon Cow / Nebulator / Space Bug Tim, Tommy and Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner. / Kai is super excited to ride the Nebulator, but Tim isn't so sure. / Tim and Kai try to photograph the illusive SpaceBug.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble and Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E4 The Crew Builds A Super Mega Movie Screen / The Crew Builds An Auntie Day Present A new Super Squirrely Whirly movie is playing at the drive-in theatre! When Speed Meister gets in the way, the pups spring into action. Can the pups finish building a present for Auntie Crane?

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E20 Haunted House Party Boo! The Bubble Guppies are invited to a costume party at a haunted house! They dress up as witches, vampires, werewolves, zombies and mummies, but who's that in the spooky ghost costume?

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E16 Super Shrimptennial Celebration To celebrate Shrimptennial, the Bubble Guppies visit Big Bubble City! Join them in discovering the hustle and bustle of the big city and the Big Bubble Building!

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E1 Gabby, I Shrunk The Kitties Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercat's potions spills.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Tiny Chef Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E6 Granola Bars / Nachos Morton the Butterfly's snack crashes on the Stump, leading Chef and Olly to compete to make him the best travel treat. / In his cooking debut, a very enthusiastic Bonzo helps Chef and Olly make nachos.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 Places At School! The fun and kind Gardener Tim, teaches his charming students Rose and Col about the different spaces inside the school, where they are able to learn and share time together as classmates.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E9 Robots in Space When Space Commander Megan is marooned on Pluto, our robot heroes will race through wormholes, shoot past ice volcanoes and blast straight through an asteroid field to bring their new friend back home.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E10 Power Tires! When his tires get popped, Blaze thinks he's out of the race for good. Luckily, Gabby is there with a new set of high-tech wheels that can transform into anything Blaze needs to keep rolling.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E3 Sea Patrol: Pups Save A Sunken Sloop / Sea Patrol: Pups Save A Wiggly Whale Pirate Sid Swashbuckle and his puppy named Arrby try to steal treasure from a submerged ship in the bay. Cap'n Turbot and Francois are chased by an unhappy whale with driftwood stuck in its teeth.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E4 Pups Save A High-Flying Skye / Pups Go For The Gold During a hurricane, a blackout hits Adventure Bay while Skye is in the middle of a mission. / Rubble sets up a barricade to stop an out-of-control mine cart with Otis Goodway's huge piece of gold.

10shakeperth.au.title: Super Duper Bunny League
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E5 Frog Face! / What's-Her-Face! The team must face off against a giant frog who wants to make a meal of Important City's. / A master of disguise impersonates Annabelle, the bunnies needs to figure out who their real friend is.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E8 Krabsy The Klown / Lords Of The Larp At Pearl's birthday party, Krabs is forced to relive his traumatic past as a clown and step into the role again. While in the Pontoon cabin, Mo learns to enjoy the odd world of role-playing games.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E2 Super Stars / Now Museum, Now You Don't In an alternate universe, the Star family is a team of superheroes, or at least they think they are. // Cecil works a new temp job as a security guard at Lady Upturn's art museum.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Smurfs
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E16 Smurfette Overdoes It! Storm gets close to beating him in a waffle-eating contest, Greedy takes the competition too far. // Gargamel sleepwalks into the Smurfs' Village, the Smurfs make the most of the situation.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Loud House
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E3 Flip This Flip/haunted House Call The Loud kids help Flip clean up his image to impress his middle school crush. // When the Mortician's Club can't afford tickets to Casket Con, they decide to start a business to raise money.

10shakeperth.au.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E17 The Northern Air Temple After hearing rumours about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E3 License To Milkshake / Squid Baby SpongeBob learns his milkshake license has expired and is forced to go back to the milkshake academy. Squidward hits his head and reverts to being a baby.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E4 Little Yellow Book / Bumper To Bumper Squidward finds SpongeBob's diary, and starts reading it out loud in the Krusty Krab. SpongeBob once again fails his driving test, forcing Mrs. Puff to think outside the box - and off the road.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E1 Your Shoe's Untied/squid's Day Off Patrick gets a new pair of shoes but doesn't know how to tie his laces. // Mr. Krabs takes the day off from the Krusty Krab and puts Squidward in charge.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E2 Something Smells/bossy Boots SpongeBob eats sea onion ice cream and his breath stinks. // When Mr. Krabs gives his daughter Pearl a job at the Krusty krab, she starts to make some changes.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S13 E279 Welcome To Binary Bottom / You're Going To Pay...Phone / A Skin Wrinkle In Time In an alternate reality, Bikini Bottom is inhabited entirely by robots. // Mr. Krabs installs a cursed payphone in the Krusty Krab. / GrandPat travels through time to get home.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S13 E280 Abandon Twits / Wallhalla The Krusty Krew builds a boat for their penny-pinching captain. // SpongeBob discovers a crazed castaway living in his walls.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E23 Sterling And Carly Aquilino Xc On this episode of Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Carly Aquilino experience the pain of a snagged skateboard in STICKY BOARDS, discover that corporate life can be fun in OFFICE ANTICS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E24 Sterling And Nina Drama II On this episode of Ridiculousness, Rob, Steelo, and Nina Drama trip down PAINCASES, do some heavy lifting in SECOND STORY MOVIN' and brace themselves for RETURNED FIRE.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E25 Sterling And Karrueche Tran Lvii On this episode of Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo and guest Karrueche Tran get turnt up with some EXTREME GEEZERS, won't eat at the table because they keep FRIDGE FEASTING.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ink Master
10shakeperth.au.description: S16 E7 Monsters Ink Artists feel the pressure when a monstrous tattoo tests loyalties. The battle heats up.
